CustomField.description: Field used to show in Login flow the missing fields in the event
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(EventType__c, ''), $Label.EventType, '') & IF(ISPICKVAL(EventType__c, '') && ISBLANK(WhatId), '/', '') & IF(ISBLANK(WhatId), $Label.account, '') & IF(ISBLANK(WhoId) && (ISPICKVAL(EventType__c, '') || ISBLANK(WhatId)), '/', '') & IF(ISBLANK(WhoId), $Label.contact, '')
CustomField.label: Missing event fields
